summary: ChatGPT ranks **#5** on share of voice (**5.4%**) and **39.1%** visibility, but the citation problem is sharper than the rank: our own pages barely surface. **openai.com is only the #5 cited domain (804 cites)**, dwarfed by **reddit.com (7,238)**, **youtube.com (4,609)** and **medium.com (1,731)**. Recovering owned citations is the highest-leverage move on this board.

By topic, visibility collapses on **API (25%)** and **Coding (32%)** — well below Safety and Speed (~50%) — so those are the pages to build or refresh first. Owned-citation share is thinnest on **Google Gemini (0.8%)** and **Perplexity (0.9%)**, the under-served engines to target, not ChatGPT itself.

actions.text: build content briefs for the **citation-gap topics** where we rank but aren't cited: **API (25%)** and **Coding (32%)**.
refresh under-cited **owned pages** (openai.com, chatgpt.com) so engines cite us over **reddit/youtube/medium**.
lift owned-citation share on the engines where we're weakest: **Google Gemini (0.8%)** and **Perplexity (0.9%)**.
